# ubiops_request_schedule (Resource)

Manages a UbiOps request schedule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ubiops_request_schedule" "example" {
  project_name = "my-project"
  name         = "my-schedule"
  object_type  = "deployment"
  object_name  = "my-deployment"
  version      = "v1"
  schedule     = "0 */6 * * *"
  enabled      = true

  request_data_json = jsonencode({
    input = "scheduled request"
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the request
- `object_name` (String) Name of deployment/pipeline for which the request schedule is made
- `object_type` (String) Type of object for which the request is made
- `project_name` (String) The name of the project.
- `schedule` (String) Schedule in crontab format

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the request schedule
- `enabled` (Boolean) Boolean value indicating whether the request schedule is enabled or disabled
- `labels` (Map of String) Dictionary containing key/value pairs where key indicates the label and value is the corresponding value of that label
- `request_data_json` (String) Input data for the request schedule
- `timeout` (Number) Timeout of the request in seconds. Defaults to 14400 when not set.
- `version` (String) Name of version for which the request schedule is made

### Read-Only

- `creation_date` (String) The date when the request schedule was created
- `id` (String) The UUID of the schedule.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ubiops_request_schedule.example my-project/my-schedule
```
